verdict.rationale: Smooth is a browser-agent API and CLI, so a sandbox or test mode is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no Smooth sandbox environment, test API keys, or test mode. The localhost tunnel for testing local or dev apps (smooth-docs-25, smooth-docs-32) lets the agent reach a user-run dev server. That is an adjacent feature plus a user-side arrangement, not a product-provided sandbox that keeps production data out of reach.
